reason: I have one apartment and I answer every guest myself, even at night. That is my hospitality, and my guests come back because they talk to me, not to a machine. With what I earn, €150 and then €35 a month for something I already do for free is too much.
objection: My guests like talking to me personally, not to a robot. If a machine answers them, they will feel like they are in a hotel, not with a family.
would_change_my_mind: If my children could not help anymore and I was too tired to answer at night, maybe, but only for Wi-Fi and parking questions, with no setup fee and around €10 a month.
